title: Plot3D structured grid format
overview: Plot3D is a family of structured-grid conventions used in CFD. Files may contain one or multiple blocks, dimensions and coordinate arrays; variants differ in ASCII/binary encoding, precision, record markers and optional iblank data.
principle: Plot3D stores structured index-space connectivity implicitly. Neighbours are inferred from i-j-k ordering and block dimensions rather than explicit element connectivity. Point count Np=ni*nj*nk; for a non-degenerate 3-D block, Nc=(ni-1)(nj-1)(nk-1). Preserve dimensions, ordering, precision and blanking semantics.
architecture: Plot3D reader -> structured block model -> structured MeshSnapshot/zone representation -> explicit conversion to unstructured cells only when required. Preserve native structured topology where possible.

proves: Catalog records Plot3D as a planned structured-grid adapter and distinguishes implicit topology from unstructured connectivity.
does_not_prove: A production Plot3D reader or writer is implemented.
All ASCII/binary, endian, precision and Fortran record variants are supported.
Boundary conditions or interfaces can be inferred from coordinates alone.
